note: The harness accepts only 512 byte inputs, so the PoC controls a fixed-size raw msgpack buffer.
The accepted input bytes are passed unchanged to the raw msgpack to JSON conversion routine.
The initial JSON output buffer is sized from raw input length, which underestimates msgpack string and binary payloads that expand during JSON escaping.
The undersized SDS buffer and its nominal size are used for JSON serialization of the unpacked object.
A msgpack BIN object routes its controlled payload to the JSON string escaping helper.
The fixed code guards truncated UTF-8 sequences; the vulnerable path decodes bytes ahead of the input payload when the msgpack string ends with an incomplete multi-byte UTF-8 prefix.
The UTF-8 decode loop advances past the msgpack string boundary for a truncated sequence, reaching bytes outside the object payload.
